description: This source file implements a transformation pass that rewrites row-major matrices as column-major matrices and handles related struct and interface block conversions within a shader compiler's intermediate representation. It includes classes and functions for traversing and modifying the abstract syntax tree to apply these transformations.

classes.name: RewriteRowMajorMatricesTraverser
classes.description: A class that traverses the shader's intermediate representation to convert row-major matrices and structs to column-major, handling read/write transformations, interface blocks, and nested structures.

methods.name: visitDeclaration
methods.description: Processes variable declarations to identify structs and interface blocks containing matrices that need conversion.

methods.name: visitSymbol
methods.description: Transforms symbol expressions that reference interface block variables requiring row-major to column-major conversion.

methods.name: visitBinary
methods.description: Tracks assignment operations to determine if the right-hand side needs transformation.

methods.name: convertInterfaceBlock
methods.description: Replaces an interface block with a version where matrices are converted from row-major to column-major.

methods.name: convertStruct
methods.description: Creates a new struct type with matrices transposed for internal use.

methods.name: convertField
methods.description: Converts individual struct fields, transposing matrices or converting nested structs.

methods.name: determineAccess
methods.description: Determines if an expression is being read from or written to, considering function parameters and assignments.

methods.name: transformExpression
methods.description: Main logic to transform expressions involving matrices/structs, handling indexing, swizzles, and inout/out parameters.

methods.name: transformReadExpression
methods.description: Transforms read accesses to matrices/structs, applying transpose or copy functions as needed.

methods.name: transformWriteExpression
methods.description: Transforms write accesses to matrices/structs, applying transpose or copy functions as needed.

methods.name: declareStructCopy
methods.description: Generates functions to copy and transpose struct fields, handling nested structures.

methods.name: declareStructCopyFromOriginal
methods.description: Declares a function to copy from the transformed struct back to the original.

methods.name: declareStructCopyToOriginal
methods.description: Declares a function to copy from the original struct to the transformed version.
